overview: Use responsive image sizes with intrinsic width/height; lazy-load below-fold thumbnails and preload at most adjacent lightbox images. Keep the selected photo by stable ID; do not automatically advance a carousel without pause and user control. The graph separates browser interaction state, server query state and the existing backend. It is one defensible approach; equivalent boundaries and well-argued alternatives are welcome.
limitations: Design checks inspect structure and written evidence only; they do not execute a UI or prove accessibility/performance.

estimation.calculation: ~5.76 MB decoded per image; 3 neighbors/active ≈17.3 MB before overhead
estimation.result: Compressed transfer size understates decoded memory; bound neighbor prefetch
estimation.implication: Profile decoded memory and image layout shifts on mobile.

components.purpose: Keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive-technology entry point. Client architecture only; backend internals are external dependencies.
components.rationale: Own this responsibility at the Browser / User boundary; keep communication explicit through the diagrammed dependency.

components.purpose: Use responsive image sizes with intrinsic width/height; lazy-load below-fold thumbnails and preload at most adjacent lightbox images. Keep the selected photo by stable ID; do not automatically advance a carousel without pause and user control. Performance plan: 2,000 metadata entries; fetch 30 thumbnails/page; lightbox prefetch only previous/next. Accessibility: Use meaningful alt text, keyboard next/previous, an accessible modal with Escape, trapped focus and focus restoration to the opened thumbnail; respect reduced motion. Failure recovery: Keep thumbnail/placeholder, expose retry, ignore old selection loads, abort expendable prefetch and revoke local object URLs. Trade-off: A static grid is simpler and avoids modal navigation complexity. Preloading all full-resolution photos is wasteful even if metadata is small.

steps.explanation: The gallery/lightbox requests responsive variants. Lazy-load offscreen thumbnails, preload only immediate neighbors and release expendable resources.

failureCases.scenario: A full-resolution image fails while navigating quickly
failureCases.handling: Keep thumbnail/placeholder, expose retry, ignore old selection loads, abort expendable prefetch and revoke local object URLs.

failureCases.scenario: Route or identity changes while work is in flight
failureCases.handling: Dispose subscriptions, abort obsolete reads and ignore old generations; partition/clear private cache before showing a new account. Preserve only explicitly safe drafts.
